purpose: Independent practice of E2.2 — comparing length and area.
student_learning_goal: I can compare and order objects by length and area.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare and order objects by length and area.
header.character_watermark: Roo with a measuring tape in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.visual_layout: 4 horizontal strips of varied length (1in, 4in, 2in, 3in) stacked vertically, aligned at the left edge. Beside each, a number box.

image_placeholders.description: 4 horizontal strips for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Lengths in mixed order from top to bottom: 2in, 4in, 1in, 3in. Each ~0.4in tall, aligned at left edge. Beside each, a small number box (~0.5in × 0.5in).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_STRIPS at Part 1: instructions ask the child to order strips by length. Keywords name the visual elements and comparison endpoints.

parts.student_instructions: Count the tiles covering each shape. Write the area in tiles.
parts.visual_layout: 3 shapes covered with grid tiles, each different size. Below each: 'Area = ___ tiles'.

image_placeholders.description: 3 shapes with tile coverage for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Shape 1: rectangle covered with 6 tiles (2×3). Shape 2: square with 4 tiles (2×2). Shape 3: rectangle with 9 tiles (3×3). Each shape ~2in. Below each, a labelled line 'Area = ___ tiles'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_TILES at Part 2: instructions ask the child to count tiles. Keywords name the visual element (tiles) and attribute (area).

parts.answer_key: Shape 1: 6 tiles. Shape 2: 4 tiles. Shape 3: 9 tiles.

parts.student_instructions: Find 3 things at home. Order them by length or area.
parts.visual_layout: Three rows numbered 1-3 with lines for object names.

image_placeholders.description: Three numbered rows for a Grade 1 worksheet. Each: '1: ___', '2: ___', '3: ___' with writing lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_ROWS at Part 3: instructions ask the child to order home objects. Keywords name the activity.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find a thing with the same area as a book.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation artifact. Use Part 2 as the formative signal — children who count tiles correctly with no gaps.
